name: Additive urinary retention risk
actions: Monitor for difficulty initiating urination, reduced urinary flow, bladder discomfort, or inability to void.
Use additional caution in patients with bladder outlet obstruction or a history of urinary retention.

rationale: Both drugs can contribute to urinary retention risk.
Combined effects may increase difficulty with bladder emptying.
